findings.evidence: README restates a generic Mermaid guide (Purpose, Key Features, Usage Examples, Getting Started, Best Practices, Tips for Success) that the agent already gets from SKILL.md and the type references
findings.fix: Keep README.md (the repo requires it) and the Credits section. Move any fact a user asks for by name into references/ if it is not already there, then record each remaining generic paragraph in docs/audit/recovery/mermaid-diagrams/record.md; do not delete the Credits lines

findings.evidence: Git gotchas cover checkout-before-branch and cherry-pick id, but not that merge needs the branch name (merge id: "rc1" is a parse error) while cherry-pick needs the commit id
findings.fix: Add one NEVER to SKILL.md Gotchas or other-diagrams.md Git: merge takes the branch name (merge hotfix), cherry-pick takes a commit id set on that commit; swapping them parses as an error

findings.evidence: Reference links https://iconify.design with no instruction to open it, while the Custom icon packs section already states the mmdc and registerIconPacks facts
findings.fix: Drop the Iconify catalog link or gate it: open it only when the user names a pack the renderer does not register; keep the official architecture docs link

findings.evidence: 28 evals and 22 trigger queries are realistic and verifiable, but several assertions are mechanical (Uses `gantt`, Uses `pie`, Uses `stateDiagram-v2`) and no grading.json or benchmark.json shows they were run
findings.fix: Keep the edge-case assertions (cardinality glyphs, unique C4 ids, quoted labels, Mermaid 12 frontmatter). Replace the type-name-only checks with an outcome the skill can get wrong, and store one graded iteration next to the skill

findings.evidence: Section 7 says write the entity codes `#35;` and `#59;` for `#` and `;` in sequence text; Mermaid's documented forms are `#35` and `#59` with no semicolon, and a trailing semicolon ends the statement
findings.fix: Change both codes to the official form `#35` and `#59`, cite https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/sequenceDiagram.html with the date checked, and keep the eval assertion in repair-sequence-end aligned with that form

findings.evidence: Step 3 says a target whose name starts with o or x after a link parses as a circle or cross edge, but the example is `A---orders` with no space, which is the ordinary edge to node orders; the circle form is `A---oB`
findings.fix: Replace the example with `A---oB` and `A---xB` as written in authoring-rules.md section 7, and say a space before the target (`A--- orders`) is the repair when the circle or cross was not intended
